description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search tax refund details. Use strt_dt/end_dt (YYYYMMDD). The NTS only serves the last 5 years from today. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

txaa_yn.description: 세무대리인 조회 여부 Y/N. 'Y'이면 txaa_id 와 txpr_dscm_no 가 함께 필요하고, 세무대리인은 지급완료('1') 건만 조회됩니다.

txpr_dscm_no.description: Taxpayer number (hyphens allowed; 세무대리인 조회 시 필수)
